What Groundwork would set up

You've already nailed the hard part — people are watching (Jon's reels, the Bastrop following, 160+ posts of real work). Right now it all dead-ends in Messenger. This turns that attention into booked jobs and Google reviews.

  • This website — your domain, your reels & photos sending viewers to actually book.
  • Google Business Profile — show up in Search & Maps, not just Facebook.
  • Estimate requests & booking — no more Messenger back-and-forth.
  • Missed-call text-back — never lose a job because you were on a ladder.
  • Reviews on autopilot — grow past 5 on Google, automatically.
  • Optional AI receptionist — answers & books after hours, add it anytime.
Starts at Groundwork's Starter/Foundation tier — and I'm open to trading for a build.
